guardians.title: The Guardians
guardians.subtitle: Iron rules your twin will never break
examples: Never discuss competitor agencies or their pricing.
Always recommend scheduling a viewing before making any purchase decisions.
Do not share exact owner contact details — direct all inquiries through the agency.
Never guarantee rental yields or investment returns.
Always clarify that prices are subject to change and require written confirmation.
